meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction. Use when the user needs to navigate websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操控浏览器完成网页操作、填表、截图与数据抓取
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要操作网页,手动填表、截图或抓数据很耗时
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser tasks like form filling, screenshots, and data extraction.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often repeat browser chores like filling forms and grabbing data.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能替你操作一台真实浏览器：打开网址、点击链接或按钮、填写表单、给页面截图、提取页面上的文字数据。
howto.when: 当你有打开网页、填写表单、截图、测试网站等网页操作需求时，Claude 会开始控制浏览器。

say.text: 打开 example.com 并保存整页截图
say.note: 会导航到网站并保存截图文件。

say.text: 把搜索框填上“测试”并搜索
say.note: 会先定位输入框，再输入并触发搜索。

say.text: 告诉我当前页面的标题和网址
say.note: 会读取浏览器当前标题和 URL 返回给你。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can operate a real browser: open URLs, click elements, fill forms, take screenshots, and extract data from pages.
howto.when_en: Trigger when the user asks to open or interact with webpages, fill forms, take screenshots, test websites, or extract page data.

say_en.text: Open example.com and save a full-page screenshot.
Fill the search box with "testing" and search.
say_en.note: Locates the input, types, and submits.

say_en.text: Tell me the title and URL of the current page.
say_en.note: Reads and returns the browser's title and URL.
